timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Part of me doubts I can have what I want.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I’ve been told wanting more is greedy.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m not sure I believe this is possible for me.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice fear underneath my wanting.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body tenses when I imagine having this.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’ve talked myself out of this before.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me is scared to hope.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit how much I actually want this.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This wanting feels vulnerable to say out loud.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can want this without needing to earn it first.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Wanting more doesn’t make me ungrateful.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to have it all figured out to start believing.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let hope in, even a little.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can relax around this desire.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to imagine this going well.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can release the doubt that isn’t mine to carry.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to take my own dreams seriously.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can trust that wanting this means something.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of creating what I want.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust that this is already on its way to me.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to have this.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can see myself living this clearly.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body believes this is possible.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m becoming someone who receives good things.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can act like this is already true for me.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m worthy of what I’m asking for.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to receive this.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this belief with you as you continue.
